title: CHAPTER 9: HINDI IN TECHNOLOGY AND COMPUTING

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Unicode standard provides uniform digital encoding for the Devanagari script across all modern computing platforms.
Hindi software tools facilitate effective text processing, translation, font conversion, and natural language processing.
Integration of Hindi in banking technology platforms enhances digital accessibility and financial inclusion.

cells: Universal encoding standard that supports all scripts including Devanagari; Unicode range for Devanagari: U+0900 to U+097F; enables Hindi on all platforms
Government standard Unicode Devanagari font; developed by C-DAC; used in all government documents; available in Windows
Google's open-source Unicode Devanagari font; excellent for web use
Pre-Unicode Indian encoding standard; now largely replaced by Unicode; legacy systems may still use it
Inscript (standard government keyboard for all Indian languages; same key positions across scripts); Phonetic/Remington; Typewriter layout
Government approved layout; standardised by BIS; same position concept across all Indic keyboards; recommended for all government Hindi typing
25 words per minute in Hindi (Devanagari) is the minimum standard for departmental typing examinations
Hindi typing in non-Unicode environments; various keyboard layouts; bilingual documents
Machine Translation tool; English to Hindi and other Indian languages; used by government offices for bulk translation
Machine translation system; English to Hindi and 9 other Indian languages; used in government
Hindi word processing and typing interface for government use; integrated with e-office
Electronic file management system for government; fully bilingual Hindi-English interface; DoOL mandates all government offices to use
Hindi software for secure e-mail and file transfer with Hindi interface
Advanced tools for Hindi natural language processing; machine translation; speech recognition
Type in Devanagari using transliteration (type phonetically in English, get Devanagari); widely used
Built-in Hindi input method; available on Windows; phonetic and InScript modes

items: Unicode standards for Devanagari script are frequently asked in Rajbhasha Officer and Computer Awareness sections.
Understand the key software tools and localization requirements used in banking technology platforms for official language compliance.

cells: RBI mandates all ATMs to have Hindi language option (along with local language); ATM screens must display transaction messages in Hindi
All bank mobile apps must provide Hindi language interface option; YONO (SBI), iMobile (ICICI), Kotak Mobile all offer Hindi
Banks must provide Hindi language option on their net banking portal; HTTPS with Hindi support
CBS vendors (Finacle, BaNCS, FLEXCUBE) provide Hindi modules; key reports and outputs must be bilingual
Cheque book, FD receipts, DD, account statements :all must be bilingual (Hindi and English); account holder's name in Devanagari optional but system must support it
New account welcome kit, passbook, debit card carrier :must be in bilingual format; Hindi version of all bank forms mandatory
